License key for sending a usage event using `@remotion/licensing`.

## CLI flag

```text
--license-key <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#licensekey)
- [`renderStillOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/renderstillonlambda#licensekey)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#licensekey)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#licensekey)
- [`renderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-media-on-web#licensekey)
- [`renderStillOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-still-on-web#licensekey)
